59716.meaning1: synonym for someone with the same preceptor

59717.meaning1: uniter; reconciler; who brings (somebody) back together (with)
59717.commentary: (DNa) mātaram'pi puttena samānetā ahosī'ti imaṃ kammaṃ rajje patiṭṭhitena sakkā kātuṃ. tasmā bodhisatto'pi rajjaṃ kārayamāno antonagare catukk'ādīsu catūsu nagaradvāresu bahinagare catūsu disāsu imaṃ kammaṃ karothā'ti manusse ṭhapesi. te mātaraṃ kuhiṃ me putto puttaṃ na passāmī'ti vilapantiṃ pariyesamānaṃ disvā ehi, amma, puttaṃ dakkhasī'ti taṃ ādāya gantvā nahāpetvā bhojetvā puttamassā pariyesitvā dassenti. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: mātaram'pi puttena samānetā ahosi, puttam'pi mātarā samānetā ahosi, pitaram'pi puttena samānetā ahosi, puttam'pi pitarā samānetā ahosi, bhātaram'pi bhātarā samānetā ahosi, bhātaram'pi bhaginiyā samānetā ahosi… samaṅgīkatvā ca abbhanumoditā ahosi.

59719.meaning1: to bring together; to unite; to connect (with)

59720.commentary: (APAa) bahū nāvā samānetvā'ti sampattaṃ taṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ disvā vaḍḍhakīhi suṭṭhu saṅkhataṃ kataṃ nipphāditaṃ bahū nāvāyo samānetvā dve dve nāvāyo ekato katvā tassā nāvāya upari maṇḍapachadanaṃ katvā

examples.text: bahū nāvā samānetvā, vaḍḍhakīhi susaṅkhataṃ, nāvāya chadanaṃ katvā, paṭimāniṃ nar'āsabhaṃ.

59723.meaning1: (of meditation attainment) enters; attains; dwells in

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu taṃ tadeva samāpattiṃ samāpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi, tassa mudu cittaṃ hoti kammaññaṃ. mudunā kammaññena cittena appamāṇo samādhi hoti subhāvito.
tassa evaṃpaṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati. sampasāde sati eta'r'ahi vā āneñjaṃ samāpajjati paññāya vā adhimuccati kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā.
yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya hatthaggāhaṃ vā veṇiggāhaṃ vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅgh'ādiseso.
yo pana bhikkhu sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyya itthiyā vā purisamatiṃ purisassa vā itthimatiṃ, jāyattane vā jārattane vā, antamaso taṅ'khaṇikāya'pi, saṅgh'ādiseso.

59726.meaning1: entering; attaining; dwelling in a meditation attainment

examples.text: na kho, gahapati, saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti, ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjissan'ti vā ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjāmī'ti vā

paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajji, catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā samanantarā bhagavā parinibbāyi.

ekam'id'āhaṃ, āvuso ānanda, samayaṃ idh'eva sāvatthiyaṃ viharāmi andhavanasmiṃ. tatth'āhaṃ tathārūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajjiṃ yathā n'eva pathaviyaṃ pathavisaññī ahosiṃ, na āpasmiṃ āposaññī ahosiṃ, na tejasmiṃ tejosaññī ahosiṃ
ahaṃ, bhante, nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjiṃ. idaṃ me nissaggiyaṃ.
abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, anekasataṃ khattiyaparisaṃ upasaṅkamitā. tatra'pi mayā sannisinnapubbañ'c'eva, sallapitapubbañ'ca, sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbā.

59733.meaning1: (of a meditation attainment) to enter; to attain
59733.commentary: (MNt) icchit'icchitakkhaṇe samāpajjituṃ samattho'ti iminā tesu jhānesu samāpajjanavasībhāvam'āha, nikāmalābhī'ti pana vacanato āvajjan'ādhiṭṭhāna-paccavekkhaṇa-vasiyo'pi vuttā evā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: akicchalābhī'ti sukhen'eva paccanīkadhamme vikkhambhetvā samāpajjituṃ samattho'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

59734.meaning2: having entered upon, having engaged in

examples.text: yāni ca kho imāni, bhikkhave, nissāya dve āyatanāni, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-samāpatti ca saññāvedayitanirodho ca, jhāyīh'ete, bhikkhave, samāpattikusalehi samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalehi samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhahitvā sammā akkhātabbānī'ti vadāmī'ti.
atha kho bhagavā tassa brahmuno upari vehāsaṃ pallaṅkena nisīdi tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā
kati pan'āvuso, paccayā adukkham'asukhāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā'ti? cattāro kho, āvuso, paccayā adukkham'asukhāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yv'āyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro cā'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako hirīmā hoti, hirīyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, hirīdhanaṃ
jegucchī hoti kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, jegucchī hoti anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.

59737.commentary: (SNa) na samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo'ti cittaṃ hāsetvā kallaṃ katvā jhānaṃ samāpajjituṃ na sakkoti.

examples.text: yāni ca kho imāni, bhikkhave, nissāya dve āyatanāni, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-samāpatti ca saññāvedayitanirodho ca, jhāyīh'ete, bhikkhave, samāpattikusalehi samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalehi samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhahitvā sammā akkhātabbānī'ti vadāmī'ti.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yv'āyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro cā'ti.

59738.commentary: (DNa) samāpattikusalatā'ti atthi savitakkasavicārā samāpatti, atthi avitakkavicāramattā samāpatti, atthi avitakka-avicārā samāpatti. yā tāsaṃ samāpattīnaṃ kusalatā paññā pajānanā'ti (dha. sa. 1338) evaṃ vuttā saha parikammena appanāparicchedajānanā paññā.

examples.text: samāpattikusalatā ca samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā ca.

ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīl'ānussatiṃ bhāveti.

59761.commentary: (ANa) samāpanno'ti sikkhaṃ paripūrento sājīvañ'ca avītikkamanto hutvā tadubhayaṃ upagato'ti attho.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī day'āpanno, sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī viharati.

na khv'āhaṃ taṃ, brāhmaṇa, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yassa so pāyaso bhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya, aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā.
tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ayaṃ kho, bhante, vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā. anekehi sambhārehi samāraddhā vadati
anekehi sambhārehi samāraddhā vadatī'ti. so taṃ vīṇaṃ dasadhā vā satadhā vā phāleyya, dasadhā vā satadhā vā taṃ phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya.

n'āhaṃ taṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇ'ācariyaṃ, api arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ, yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya, yassa na kacchehi sedā mucceyyuṃ.
abhijānām'ahaṃ, bho gotama, pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabhitā. so'pi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññen'aññaṃ paṭicari, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātv'ākāsi.
bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārabbhā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo'ti,
thūṇaṃ ce'p'āhaṃ acetanaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabheyyaṃ, sā'pi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddhā saṅkampeyya sampakampeyya sampavedheyya. ko pana vādo manussabhūtassā'ti?

59786.commentary: (DNa) yassa kassaci nīlatiṇarukkh'ādikassa bhūtagāmassa ca samārambhā, chedanabhedanapacan'ādibhāvena vikopanā paṭivirato'ti attho.

atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ek'āyanena maggena tam'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ paṇidhāya. tam'enaṃ cakkhumā puriso disvā evaṃ vadeyya, tath'āyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso paṭipanno tathā ca iriyati tañ'ca maggaṃ samārūḷho, yathā imaṃ'y'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ āgamissatī'ti.
